run_conv2d_resample: run 2D convolution with optional upsampling and downsampling on a PyTorch tensor using conv2d_resample
run_conv2d_resample_upsample: run conv2d_resample with an upsampling factor to increase spatial resolution of a feature map
run_conv2d_resample_downsample: run conv2d_resample with a downsampling factor to decrease spatial resolution of a feature map
review_conv2d_wrapper: review the _conv2d_wrapper function that handles conv2d and conv_transpose2d with cuDNN 8.0.5 performance workarounds
summarize_get_weight_shape: summarize the _get_weight_shape helper that extracts and validates the 4D weight tensor shape
